hints.title: Dual Indexing by Food and Cuisine
hints.text: Maintain mapping from each food to its cuisine and rating, along with rating rankings partitioned by cuisine.

hints.title: Lazy Deletion Strategy
hints.text: When modifying a food rating, push the updated score to the cuisine ranking pool and discard outdated entries lazily.

hints.title: Lexicographical Tie Breaking
hints.text: Order ratings descending and food names ascending to resolve ties deterministically.

hints.title: Cuisine Priority Pools Implementation

complexity.time: O(log n) for changeRating, amortized O(log n) for highestRated
complexity.notes: Lazy priority queue pruning amortizes cleanly.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning foods per cuisine query takes O(n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stores inverted cuisine heaps and food metadata.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Designs state using lazy deletion or ordered sets with lexicographical tie-breakers.

solutions.approach: Hash Maps with Lazy Heap Pruning
